name: Slack
author: leonavas
description: Unofficial Slack client inside the Omarchy shell, not affiliated with Slack: sign in with Slack's own page, sidebar sections, channels, DMs, threads, reactions, search, statuses, pauses and several workspaces, drawn in the theme's colors. The bar icon opens it and badges what is waiting.

barWidget.description: Slack in the shell: click to open or hide the window, red and blue badges for DMs and channels, a preview of what is unread on hover, desktop notifications for new messages, pauses.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Outline draws Slack's white mark with a faint dark edge, readable on light and dark bars. Color draws the mark in Slack's colors. Mono draws the white mark tinted with the bar's color. Glyph draws any Nerd Font character instead.

schema.label: Glyph
schema.description: Only used by the Glyph style.

schema.label: Glyph size (px)
schema.description: 0 follows the bar's icon size. Only used by the Glyph style.

schema.label: Vertical nudge (px)
schema.description: Negative moves the glyph up, for glyphs whose ink sits off the bar's line.

schema.label: Unread badge
schema.description: Two badges at once: unread DM and group DM messages and thread replies that mention you at the bottom-right in red, channel mentions and new replies in threads you follow at the top-right in blue. A badge with nothing to count is not drawn. Dot marks the same corners without numbers.

schema.label: Badge layout
schema.description: Split shows DMs (red, bottom-right) and channels (blue, top-right) as two badges. Combined shows one badge, bottom-right, with their sum: red while a DM waits, blue when only channels do. The icon's menu toggles this as "Group notifications".

schema.label: DM badge color
schema.description: Bottom-right badge: unread messages in DMs and group DMs. Empty follows the theme's urgent color.

schema.label: Channel badge color
schema.description: Top-right badge: channel messages. Empty uses the DM color.

schema.label: Channel badge counts
schema.description: Unread counts the messages that mention you plus the unread channels that notify you (not muted and not set to mentions only in Slack) plus new replies in threads you follow. Mentions counts only the channel mentions. All unread adds every unread channel. None drops the channel badge.

schema.label: Dot size
schema.description: The dot's diameter as a fraction of the icon. Only used by the Dot badge.

schema.label: Color the icon while something is waiting
schema.description: Mono and Glyph styles only: the mark takes the DM color, or the channel color when only channels are waiting.

schema.label: What a click on the open window does
schema.description: Special workspace parks the window in a hidden Hyprland special workspace, where it stays as it was. Middle click (or Close Slack in the menu) closes it instead; the app keeps counting and notifying either way.

schema.label: Name of the special workspace
schema.description: Used as special:<name>. "scratchpad" is Omarchy's own, toggled with SUPER+S.

schema.label: Open straight into the special workspace
schema.description: The window opens in special:<name>, and a click shows or hides that workspace. The icon's menu toggles this as "Open in Scratchpad".

schema.label: Open the window when the shell starts
schema.description: The app itself always runs with the shell; this opens its window too. The icon's menu toggles this as "Launch on Login".

schema.label: Show and focus the window when it opens
schema.description: Off, the window opens in the background, parked in the special workspace without taking the focus (nor marking anything read), also when opened from the icon. The icon's menu toggles this as "Launch in Foreground".

schema.label: Dim the icon while the window is closed or signed out
Remove the icon from the bar while signed out
Messages shown per conversation
schema.description: The newest unread messages of each conversation in the preview, up to 5.

schema.label: Preview every unread channel
schema.description: Off, the preview lists DMs, group DMs, channels that mention you and channels that notify you, and only counts the muted or mentions-only ones. On, every unread channel gets a row.

schema.label: Channel mentions only
schema.description: On, a channel only gets a row and counts in the blue badge when it mentions you; every other unread channel only counts in the preview's footer. Off, channels that notify you (not muted, not set to mentions only in Slack) count too. The icon's menu toggles this as "Channel mentions only".

schema.label: Show reactions to your messages
schema.description: Lists the reactions other people put on your messages in the preview, and floats each new one up out of the icon. They never add to the badges. The icon's menu toggles this as "Show reactions".

schema.label: Show threads you follow
schema.description: Lists the threads you follow with new replies in the preview. Replies that mention you add to the red badge, the other new replies to the blue one (not with the channel badge set to Mentions or None). The icon's menu toggles this as "Show threads".

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: A notification for each new message that notifies you in Slack (DMs, mentions, channels set to every message, replies in threads you follow) and each reaction to your messages, except while notifications are paused and for the conversation you have open on screen. A click opens the conversation at that message. The icon's menu toggles this as "Desktop notifications", and so does Slack's Preferences.

schema.label: Show the message in notifications
schema.description: Off, notifications say who wrote and where, but not what. Slack's Preferences toggles this as "Show message preview".

schema.label: While notifications are paused
schema.description: A pause you set hides both badges. Bell fades the mark and puts a small bell-off in the bottom-right corner, Dim fades the whole icon, None shows nothing. Slack's scheduled night-time DND keeps the badges.
